attributes.name: dark band color
attributes.definition: The fill color of the dark full-width band/section(s) with light text.

values.definition: Band filled with dark navy blue.
Dark band in another color, or color unspecified.

attributes.name: dark band placement
attributes.definition: Where the dark full-width band(s) with light text appear on the page.

values.definition: Top bar, nav and footer are dark bands.
A standalone dark band within page content, e.g. a callout or CTA section.

attributes.name: band text and element treatment
attributes.definition: The light-colored elements used inside the dark band.

values.definition: Only white text, no buttons or tags.
Text with a filled white pill button, often with weight contrast between lines.
